textbookText: Section 'D’ Long answer type questions 1. Observe the diagram and answer the following questions: i) Which phenomenon is shown in the diagram. Ans:- The phenomenon shown in the diagram is dispersion of white light through a prism. ii) Which color of light has the shortest wave length? Ans:- Violet light has the shortest wavelength. iii) Write name of electromagnetic wave having the wave length more than red ray. Ans:- The electromagnetic wave with a wavelength longer than red light is infrared radiation. iv) Why does a ray of white light split into seven different colour rays on passing through prism? Ans:- White light splits into seven colours because different wavelengths of light are refracted by different amounts in the prism, causing them to separate into a spectrum. 2. Study the given diagram of dispersion of light and answer the following questions: i) Name the colour of rays A and B Ans:- The color of ray A is red and B is violet ii) Why does the ray B bend more than A? Ans:- Ray B is violet light which has a shorter wavelength and a higher refractive index in the glass prism. Therefore violet light slows down more inside the prism and undergoes greater deviation than red light. iii) What happen when another prism is kept inverted between the prism and screen? Write with reason. Ans:- The inverted prism recombines the dispersed colors and the colors converge again and form white light on the screen because the second prism bends the ray in the opposite direction, cancelling the dispersion produced by the first prism. Thus, the spectrum recombines to produce white light. 3. Study the given diagram and answer the following questions. i) What is the name of ∡LSA in such condition? Ans:- The angle ∡LSA is called the critical angle in this condition. ii) What effect is seen to the ray SR when ∡LSA is increased? Mention the name of that condition. Ans:- When ∡LSA is increased beyond the critical angle, the ray SR is reflected back inside the denser medium, and this effect is called total internal reflection. iii) Write one application of the process obtained due to increase in ∡LSA. Ans:- One application of the total internal reflection is its use in optical fibres for fast communication. 4. In the figure a ray of light travelling from medium P to medium Q is shown. XY is the boundary between two medium and MN⊥ XY. Answer the questions given below with the help of given figure. i) Which lines represent the incident ray and refracted ray? Ans:- In the given figure, line AB represents the incident ray and line CD represents the refracted ray. ii) Which medium do you think denser? Give reason. Ans:- Medium Q is denser than medium P because the refracted ray bends towards the normal when it enters medium Q, which happens only when light travels from a rarer medium to a denser medium. iii) Draw a ray diagram to show the critical angle.

Ans:- The type of defect of vision shown in the diagram is Myopia ( short-sightedness). Concave lens is used to treat that defect.
